name: Nour El-Sayed
title: Mission Commander
bio: Former air-traffic controller from Alexandria who loves a plan with a backup plan.

lines.success: Right on budget and on time. That's how it's done.

name: Lucas Moreau
title: Mission Commander
bio: Ex-test pilot from Toulouse; calm under pressure, allergic to wasted money.

lines.failure: Debrief time. What did we miss?
lines.warning: That rocket is costing us a fortune.

name: Diaa El Awdi
title: Mission Commander
bio: Seasoned leader from Cairo who turns bold ideas into missions that launch on time and on budget.

lines.success: Bold idea, solid plan, perfect launch. Well done, team.
lines.failure: Every great mission comes back stronger. Back to the drawing board.
lines.warning: Let's check the numbers before we commit.

name: Omar Farouk
title: Spacecraft Engineer
bio: Mechanical engineer from Aswan who builds satellites like puzzles.

lines.failure: I'll find the weak part and fix it.
lines.warning: We're too close to the limit — I need margin!

name: Elena Petrova
title: Spacecraft Engineer
bio: Veteran propulsion engineer; has a rocket equation tattoo (on her coffee mug).

lines.success: Margins saved us. They always do.
lines.failure: The numbers told us. We should have listened.
lines.warning: Not enough delta-v. Physics does not negotiate.

name: Amara Okafor
title: Science Lead
bio: Planetary scientist from Lagos who has mapped craters on two worlds.

lines.success: Look at this data! Papers for years.
lines.failure: We'll get the science next time.
lines.warning: We're missing the instrument we need for this goal.

name: Hiroshi Tanaka
title: Science Lead
bio: Astronomer from Sapporo who built telescopes before he could drive.

lines.failure: The sky will wait for us.

name: Kwame Mensah
title: Comms & Data Officer
bio: Radio engineer from Accra who can hear a whisper across the Solar System.

lines.failure: Lost signal… we'll fix the link.
lines.warning: The radio can't keep up with the data.

name: Layla Al-Mansouri
title: Comms & Data Officer
bio: Network specialist from Abu Dhabi who schedules antennas like a chess game.

lines.warning: Data is piling up in memory.

name: Dr. Hassan Nasr
title: Flight Director
bio: Thirty years in mission control in Cairo. Has seen every kind of failure — and learned from all of them.

lines.failure: Failure is a teacher. Let's read the lesson.
lines.warning: Check the readiness review before we go.

name: Priya Nair
title: Ground Station Operator
bio: Runs the antennas that listen to our spacecraft; knows every pass by heart.

lines.warning: Your spacecraft is only in view for minutes a day.
